provenance.data: catch_outcomes.ts --cases=train, seeds 101 and 202 over the 61 training source songs (catalog v4, eval songs excluded), <=48 evaluations per interval, accepted and rejected alike
provenance.trained: numpy tanh MLP, masked MSE + logistic failure head, Adam, 8 epochs, cosine rate

input_notes.f: the 57 policy features (7 arrival, 40 body points, 10 authored future)
input_notes.controls: entry/exit relative to the arrival heading (deg), turn (deg), support as a fraction of span; optional fields 0 when absent with has_ flags; side = contactSide (default 1)
